tools.name: quote_letter
tools.description: Get an itemized price for 1-10 pages or count a base64 PDF. Quoting is free. Unknown input fields are rejected with invalid_request; error.fix names each unknown field and the accepted fields. For a return receipt, use service certified_err. One page costs $9.04 for certified or $12.24 with an elect

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "send_letter_now" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: send_letter_now · Private data: get_letter, list_letters, send_letter_now, cancel_letter · Public sink: create_letter, send_letter_now · Destructive: create_letter.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: send_letter_now · Private data: get_letter, list_letters, send_letter_now, cancel_letter · Public sink: create_letter, send_letter_now · Destructive: create_letter

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
